versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Web3 B2B Positioning skill.
- Provides modular frameworks for positioning, messaging, and explaining Web3 products to enterprise buyers.
- Includes tools for translating technical features into business value, developing pitch decks and one-pagers, and handling objections from compliance and risk teams.
- Offers templates and processes to create sales collateral, identify buyer personas, and build trust with traditional companies.
- Designed for Web3 founders, protocol marketers, and solution sellers aiming to engage corporate clients.
